description: The fast lookup, for many names at once (up to 500, or one name across every ending with tlds ["all"]): taken or not from DNS and public registry records (RDAP), with registrar and expiry, parked-for-sale, and for names with no record the ending's list price and a buy_url. Costs no registrar call, so use it first and widely; it is NOT availability, so confirm the names you will offer with search_domains (the registrar's answer and exact price). If the call runs out of lookups, pending lists the names to send again. No sign-in needed.

details.description: Fetch the registry record for taken names too (registrar, dates). Default: on for up to 20 names.

name.description: A name without an ending, e.g. noren

tlds.description: Endings to try with name; ["all"] for every ending Nymwell sells; defaults to com, ai, dev, app, io, co, tw

name: screen_domains
title: Screen many domain names
